observation: The owner requires a shortcut that only squares the existing 3D model; source view IDs and changing camera-up interaction axes caused misleading view state and changed drag behavior.
cause: Source evidence views, geometric inspection poses, orbit input coordinates and annotation eligibility were conflated.
proposed_rule: Keep source views and generic orthographic quick views distinct. A quick snap changes only the pose, retaining default orbit input behavior, zoom/frustum scale, orbit pivot, selection and display settings. Retain the complete mesh set subject to existing hide/isolate and physical occlusion. Use a stable interaction frame even for rolled top and bottom views, and test actual horizontal/vertical drags against default 3D. Preserve correct handedness of underside projections. Do not claim behavioral verification from camera vectors alone.
limits: Supersedes conflation of source-linked elevations with generic quick faces; earlier lesson records remain historical. A202 mappings stay project-local. Browser mouse tests compare exact undamped response and retain production default damping; phone viewport emulation is not physical-device testing. Source accuracy and fabrication approval are outside this correction.
